items.title: Where the August floods began
items.blurb: A massive ice and rock avalanche from Langtang Lirung plunged into the Lhende river on August 26, triggering devastating floods that swept through Rasuwa, Nuwakot and Dhading.

items.title: Telecom regulator and operators face minister’s ire over poor service
items.blurb: Communications Minister Bikram Timilsina warns of action against service providers that fail to meet licence conditions, and questions the need for a regulator unable to hold them accountable.

items.title: Three months on, flood survivors still await government response
items.blurb: With no resettlement plan, delayed rental assistance and relief running out, survivors face winter without secure shelter as aid organisations begin to withdraw.

items.title: Nepal’s fossil fuel push clashes with its clean energy ambitions
items.blurb: As the country seeks climate finance and promotes hydropower exports, new petroleum pipeline projects risk locking it into decades of fossil fuel dependence.

items.title: Keep Himalayan settlements out of harm’s way
items.blurb: Monitoring and early warnings alone are insufficient without context-sensitive settlement planning.
